checks.detail: TaskSpec envelope payload_sha256 matches the committed T4 spec; allowed_files cover run_research.py, operations.py, the ops CLI test, and all evidence outputs; baseline and six input evidence references hash-match live files.

run_research.py registers status|audit|doctor|export subcommands; each cmd_* calls only operations read-only functions, never constructs a Runner, never opens Holdout, and never writes repository files; tests assert Runner construction raises AssertionError.

status renders campaign, budget, lease, roster, generation, evidence, access, usage, publication, and failure surfaces; usage reflects journal event count and max sequence from the read-only snapshot.
audit returns a deterministic JSON manifest (two calls byte-identical) with journal ref/hash, event counts, and redaction flags; the serialized manifest contains neither 'secret' nor 'holdout'.

The synthetic read-only functions reject authority/operational store paths with ProtectedStoreError; the real-store CLI reader opts in with allow_real=True and still only reads via a query_only connection.
The only tracked changes are run_research.py, operations.py, and tests/test_control_plane_ops_cli.py; no sealed TCB, policy, inventory, authority, or store file changed.

The test module failed before implementation (RED), then passed 7/7 after implementation (GREEN): readonly status without runner, surface rendering, deterministic redacted audit, doctor report, export without writes, protected-path rejection, and CLI entry guard integrity.

Authority pre-state is slice-completion ready: authorization CLAIMED, grant ACTIVE, T4 ticket ISSUED with zero trusted receipts, one open ticket, succeeded=(T1,T2,T3), no failed/in-doubt, pending outbox 0, no P7 closure.
